# Third-Party Notices

<!-- Generated by `cargo about generate about.hbs -o THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. Edit about.hbs, not this file. -->

ArtServer itself is licensed under the MIT License (see `LICENSE`). It includes the components below,
which keep their own licenses. ArtServer does not relicense any of them.

This file has two parts:

1. Material compiled into ArtServer that Cargo's package metadata does not describe: the VectorCraft
   attribution, the bundled fonts, the PDF resources and the IJG notice.
2. [The license texts of every Rust crate compiled into ArtServer](#rust-crates), generated from
   `Cargo.lock` by cargo about.

No component is licensed under the GPL, LGPL, MPL or a proprietary license (`cargo deny check licenses`
with `deny.toml`).

## VectorCraft

- Source: https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft (v0.14.0, commit `ad0566943ab9741e6356bbc9b53c3cc09895068d`)
- Crates used: `vectorcraft-engine`, `vectorcraft-render`, `vectorcraft-text` and the internal crates they depend on
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0
- Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the VectorCraft contributors

ArtServer is based on VectorCraft by the ArtCraft team. It is not an official VectorCraft derivative
and is not endorsed by the ArtCraft team. The ArtCraft name, wordmark and mark are not open source and
are not used by ArtServer (VectorCraft `docs/brand/LICENSE-brand.txt`).

## craft-libs (PDF backend)

- Source: https://github.com/storytold/craft-libs (rev `ca50d63b773c99f96e75c77ce5a1d21e7c9cda0d`; `craft-docpath` from rev `82a24b006eefa036b43c09a67fb9a3fbd17ffe63`)
- Components: `craft-pdf`, `craft-docpath`, and the patched `krilla`, `hayro-syntax`, `hayro-interpret`, `hayro-jbig2`
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0
- Copyright (c) 2026 ArtCraft Team and the craft-libs contributors; Copyright (c) The Hayro Authors

The PDF reader compiles in the resources below. Their license texts follow in this file.

- **Adobe CMap resources** (through `hayro-cmap`) — BSD-3-Clause, Copyright 1990-2023 Adobe. The
  names of Adobe and its contributors may not be used to endorse or promote ArtServer.
- **Foxit / PDFium standard fonts** (through `hayro-interpret`) — BSD-3-Clause, Copyright 2014 PDFium
  Authors; original code copyright 2014 Foxit Software Inc.
- **ICC profiles** — `CGATS001Compat-v2-micro.icc` in `hayro-interpret` (Clinton Ingram) and the
  profiles shipped with `krilla` are dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0.

craft-libs vendors krilla 0.8.2 (https://github.com/LaurenzV/krilla, upstream commit
`3ffdf0588cf98050aad6edba51ca70162e1fb5b5`, MIT OR Apache-2.0) without its license files, so the
[Rust crates](#rust-crates) section lists krilla under the generic MIT License text. Its MIT notice is:

```text
The IJG distribution formerly included code to read and write GIF files. pub fn escape(text: &str) -> String {
```
```text
    let mut quoted = String::new();
    escape_into(text, &mut quoted);
    quoted
}

fn escape_into(text: &str, buf: &mut String) {
    buf.reserve(text.len());
    for c in text.chars() {
        if is_meta_character(c) {
            buf.push('\\');
        }
        buf.push(c);
    }
}

fn is_meta_character(c: char) -> bool {
    match c {
        '\\' | '.' | '+' | '*' | '?' | '(' | ')' | '|' | '[' | ']' | '{' | '}' | '^' | '$'
        | '#' | '&' | '-' | '~' => true,
        _ => false,
    }
}

```
